decisions.reason: Changing the backend source for metadata attributes does not alter which NFT properties follow the asset after transfer.
Using live on-chain metadata does not change the requirement to deploy on Base.
The metadata attribute source does not change royalty amounts, enforcement, funding behavior, or marketplace policy.
The candidate governs presentation of NFT media and information; selecting a live on-chain metadata source does not change its rendering acceptance behavior.
The metadata source change does not alter which contract NFTs must be discoverable in owner wallet or dashboard views.
The NFT's referral identity remains its own token serial and remains displayed in metadata; the source decision only changes how metadata attributes are obtained.
The accepted backend metadata source does not necessarily revise any current FAQ copy or topic.
The metadata source decision does not change the randomness provider, draw applicability, or winner-selection execution.
Reading metadata attributes from live on-chain state does not change badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
The metadata attribute source does not alter when mint-success feedback appears or which confirmed token ID it displays.
The metadata source change does not affect the deferred Transak provider, wallet provisioning, payment methods, or mint destination.
Using live on-chain metadata does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
